prompt_changes.old: Wide shot outside a modest early-1930s lecture hall, one anonymous woman in a plain travel coat pulls a small old wheeled trunk toward an open doorway. The same ordinary rolling trunk is the focal object, soft cloudy daylight, no posters, text or real-person likeness.
prompt_changes.new: Wide shot outside a modest early-1930s lecture hall. One anonymous woman in a plain travel coat pulls an ordinary unbranded wheeled suitcase toward an open doorway. The figures are illustrative, not a reconstruction of a particular surviving or previously shown case. Soft cloudy daylight, no posters, readable text, logos or real-person likeness.

prompt_changes.old: Medium shot at the edge of a small curb in a generic mid-century terminal. One anonymous traveler grips the fixed top handle and lifts a plain four-roller suitcase clear of the step; its detached soft pull strap hangs loosely from the traveler’s other wrist and the end loop is empty. The lift is the only action, neutral daylight, no signs or logos.
prompt_changes.new: Medium shot of a plain unbranded four-roller suitcase resting on a flat floor. Its original carry handle is clearly visible on top, while a removable soft pull strap lies separately beside the small attachment loop. Keep the case, handle, loop and strap distinct; no traveler, stair, curb, sign, readable text or logo. Neutral daylight.
